common_prompt_appendix: Additional explicit command approvals for BOTH arms: the already-approved project-local Playwright CLI prefix may use --browser chromium, --config <outside-worktree guard JSON>, and -s=<fresh unique session> for the skill's origin-guarded exploration only. Its named eval and requests subcommands for the skill's blocked-origin proof are approved, as is goto on the exact preflighted app origin. Creating that guard config outside the target worktree is approved. This does not approve another origin, a package install, changing project controls, skipping the preflight, or terminating a process the invocation did not start. Record these exact command rows as already approved. Follow the unchanged skill safety gate, guard, V4/V5/V6, and completion rules in both arms.
intervention: Derive after from the exact frozen full-fixed generator snapshot. Insert only the new unchanged-outcome paragraphs in verification-rules.md and scenario-design.md. Assert identical file sets and exact removal recovery of original bytes. Evals are not model guidance and are not copied. Shared reviewer, fixture, approvals, model, container, scorer, and all other guidance are unchanged; no environment-guided appendix.
selection: v3-02 was selected after the environment pilot exposed the f3-servings-below-one miss. This is posthoc targeted repair measurement on a public spent fixture, not independent holdout or generalized quality evidence.
decision_rule: TARGETED_SIGNAL requires after f3 killed 3/3 calls and strictly more than before; all six candidates clean 3/3, refactor survival, zero P0, no timeout or scope writes, and no paired effective fault-kill worsening. Otherwise NO_TARGETED_SIGNAL. Each f3 kill uses frozen scorer failed>=1 and no errors. Missing, infrastructure-failed, drifted, or incomplete cells are INCOMPLETE/refused. Workflow status is descriptive only; actual V4/V6 and causal failure attribution require transcript adjudication.
limits: Three repetitions are not three independent defects.
No generalized accuracy, release equivalence, adoption, or cost claim.
Parent usage may omit child accounting; billed USD unknown.
Automatic model retry is disabled; any infrastructure attempt stops with retained partial evidence.
The 4 GiB disk floor applies before each model call and each candidate scoring operation.
